text: Kaylee, you did it! You won the Thailand Explorer trophy!
This is Thailand! Tap a picture to explore.
In Thailand, we say Sawasdee to say hello!
The elephant is Thailand's special animal!
Thailand's flag is red, white and blue!
Thai cars drive on the left!
We're at Agong's house in Thailand, Kaylee!
Tap the door to go inside!
Tap your family to say hello!
This is your room! Try the mattress!
I don't need to go to the bathroom!
Tap the stairs to go up to your room!
A spirit house! Thai families give it flowers and a drink.
Put your hands together and bow. In Thailand, that is a wai!
A tuk-tuk! It goes tuk tuk tuk!
Thai families eat rice every day!
The lucky cat waves for good luck!
A gecko! It sings took-geh, took-geh!
Lots of people in Thailand ride motorbikes!
Hi sweetie! This is our room!
Hi Kaylee! Welcome to Agong's house!
Sawasdee ka, Kaylee! Are you hungry?
Sawasdee ka, Kaylee! Look at Agong's treasures!
Want to sit on my motorbike?
Kaylee, are you ready to go on a trip?
Where do you want to go, Kaylee?
Tap your things to pack them, Kaylee!
It's hot and sunny at the sea!
It's too full! Sit on it!
Bring Agong a photo of the Nail Island!
Aunty Sri is here! Hop in!
Put your suitcase on the belt!
Tray down, then press the button!
Thailand looks like an elephant's head!
Our longtail boat! Tie on ribbons for good luck!
Look! The sky is turning pink!
Tap a ribbon to tie it on!
Put your finger on the water to drive!
Push the ball back with the boat!
Lie down! The roof is low!
Paddle back out to the boat!
Thai boats wear ribbons for good luck!
A longtail has a car engine on a stick!
The sea nibbled a notch in the rock!
Houses on stilts, over the sea!
The kids here built a football field that floats!
Hong means room, a secret room!
Mangrove trees stand on their roots!
Boats stay back so the Nail Island keeps standing!
A needlefish! It skips over the water!
A sea eagle! It fishes with its feet!
The village cat lives on a boat!
This crab waves its big claw!
A monitor lizard swims like a croc!
A kingfisher! A flash of blue!
This porpoise has no fin on its back!
A boat race! Drive through the rainbow gate!
Hold your finger on the water to go fast!
A ramp! Tap in the air for a trick!
A trophy for Kaylee, the boat race champion!
Tap the boat to go back to the bay!
Kaylee, Boat Race Champion! From Thailand.
Look! They each want a snack!
Elephants or the boat? You pick!
Tap the cup to make a drink!
Tap the elephant to go see them!
Tap an elephant for a splash!
Tap the boat to go to the sea!
An elephant's trunk is its nose and its hand!
Elephants eat almost all day long!
In Thailand, everyone has a fun nickname!
Tap Agong to give it to him!
Tap the plane to fly home!
Pack again, or go straight to the boat?
Let's plant rice, Kaylee! Walk in the water.
Rice likes water! Open the gate.
The birds want the rice! Shoo, shoo!
It's golden! Time to cut the rice.
Bang the rice! The grains fall out.
In Nan, people eat sticky rice with their fingers!
The steps on the hill keep the water for the rice!
Walk through the water to plant!
Tap the gate to let the water in!
Want to see real rice grow, Kaylee?
Welcome to HarborLand, Kaylee! Tap a place to play!
A puppy with a sore paw! Grab a tool!
A baby elephant with a sniffly trunk!
Everyone is better! Thank you, Doctor Kaylee!
The thermometer goes in its mouth!
Pull out the thorn with the tweezers!
Rub cream on the sore paw!
Wrap a bandage round the paw!
An x-ray shows the bones inside!
I want a new look, Kaylee!
Grab a tool and do his hair!
Now colors and the hair dryer!
Squirt the grow tonic on his hair!
A spinning pole means haircuts here!
Lift the jar and pour it in the cup!
Make the drink in the bubble!
Thai drinks! Two cups at once!
Put a straw in the cup!
Drop in the fruit from the bubble!
Cha yen is Thai iced tea! It's orange!
A slide race, Kaylee! Tap the steps to climb!
Tap, tap, tap to go fast!
Now tap at each bump to fly!
Can you build higher than me, Kaylee?
Grab a brick from the box!
Put a brick on the picture!
Tap the tower to push it!
A chedi is a Thai temple tower!
Climb the Golden Mountain, Kaylee! Count the holds!
In Bangkok, the Golden Mount has over 300 steps!
In Lopburi, monkeys live all over town!
Sawasdee krap, Kaylee! First we say thank you.
The wai kru dance says thank you to your teacher!
Muay Thai is Thailand's own sport!
In Thai, one, two, three is nueng, song, saam!
Climb up high, then slide down!
Phi Ta Khon is a festival with big funny masks!
Tap a slide to ride it!
Sharing fairly means everyone gets the same!
Pull a slice to a plate!
Mommy is driving! Hop in, Kaylee!
Ho ho! What is that, Kaylee?
Ho ho ho! Look at Daddy's hair!
Tap Agong to give him the box!
Welcome to HarborLand! Socks on, please!
ICONSIAM is by the Chao Phraya river!
At HarborLand, everyone wears grip socks!
Lopburi is a town full of monkeys!
The Golden Mount is a temple on a hill in Bangkok!
Muay Thai boxers dance the wai kru to thank their teacher!
Cha yen is Thai iced tea. It's orange!
